{"action": "edit", "reason": "Stage-1 output floats: the 20 MOhm bleed injects about 46 nA, far too little to fix out1 against the roughly 50 nA diode/mirror mismatch. That drives M2 into triode and turns off M5/M6. A 1.5 MOhm bleed pins out1 near pb, so M2 saturates and stage 2 gets its drive."}

```python
VDD = 1.8
GMID_REF, L_REF = 18.0, 0.5   # reference diode for all NMOS mirrors

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":  (20.0, 14.0, 22.0),       # NMOS pair gm/Id
    "L_in":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),         # NMOS pair length (shorter -> less gate cap)
    "gmid_ld":  (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),         # PMOS load / pb-generator gm/Id
    "L_ld":     (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),          # PMOS load length
    "I_tail":   (2.5e-6, 1e-6, 4e-6),     # stage-1 tail current
    "I_s2":     (3.5e-6, 2e-6, 4.5e-6),   # stage-2 CS / pb-generator current
    "gmid_s2":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),        # stage-2 CS gm/Id
    "L_s2":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),         # stage-2 length
    "I_inv":    (100e-6, 40e-6, 200e-6),  # output inverter peak drive (dynamic only)
    "L_inv":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),        # inverter length
    "gmid_inv": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),         # inverter gm/Id (lower -> smaller gate cap)
    "R_bleed":  (1.5e6, 0.5e6, 5e6),      # stage-1 output bleed to pb: pins out1 near pb
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec["cl"]
    vod = spec["vod"]
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    # bias mirrors (same gm/Id and L as reference diode)
    m0   = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt   = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, p["I_tail"], vds=0.6)
    mpbn = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, p["I_s2"], vds=0.6)

    # stage 1: NMOS pair, PMOS diode load M3 with mirror copy M4
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.6)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.6)

    # stage 2: NMOS CS (gate out1) with PMOS current source (gate pb)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_s2"], p["L_s2"], p["I_s2"], vds=0.5)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_s2"], vds=0.6)

    # output CMOS inverter
    mon = lut.size("n", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], p["I_inv"], vds=0.9)
    mop = lut.size("p", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], p["I_inv"], vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias network
    n.dev("M0",   "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("Mt",   "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("Mpbn", "pb",    "ibias", "vss", "vss", mpbn)
    n.dev("M7",   "pb",    "pb",    "vdd", "vdd", m6)   # pb diode, sources I_s2
    # stage 1
    n.dev("M1", "out_a", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1",  "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "out_a", "out_a", "vdd", "vdd", m3)      # diode load
    n.dev("M4", "out1",  "out_a", "vdd", "vdd", m4)      # mirror copy, ratio 1
    # DC bleed (1.5 MOhm): pins out1 near pb so M2 stays saturated and M5 has a DC level
    n.R("Rb", "out1", "pb", p["R_bleed"])
    # stage 2 (inverting)
    n.dev("M5", "out2", "out1", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "out2", "pb",   "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # output inverter (inverting)
    n.dev("MPo", "vout", "out2", "vdd", "vdd", mop)
    n.dev("MNo", "vout", "out2", "vss", "vss", mon)

    # first-order predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    G1 = m1.gds + m3.gds + m4.gds + 1.0 / p["R_bleed"]
    A1 = gm1 / G1
    gm5 = m5.gm
    A2 = gm5 / (m5.gds + m6.gds)
    Ainv = (mon.gm + mop.gm) / (mon.gds + mop.gds)

    C1 = m5.cgg + m1.cdd + m4.cdd
    C2 = mon.cgg + mop.cgg + m5.cdd + m6.cdd
    tau1 = C1 / gm1
    tau2 = C2 / gm5

    gain_tot = max(A1 * A2 * max(Ainv, 1.0), 1.0)
    t_lin = (tau1 + tau2) * math.log(max((VDD / 2) / (gain_tot * vod), 1.0))
    t_slew = cl * (VDD / 2) / p["I_inv"]
    tpd = t_lin + t_slew

    # supply: reference + tail + M6 + pb generator (inverter is static-free)
    power = VDD * (iref + p["I_tail"] + 2.0 * p["I_s2"])

    # tail headroom (positive = ok)
    tail_headroom = vcm - m1.vgs - mt.vdsat

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd,
        "power": power,
        "polarity_ok": 1.0,
        "tail_headroom": tail_headroom,
        "A1": A1, "A2": A2, "Ainv": Ainv,
    }
```
